row1.text: 1 · Why v3, your feedback, and the research

sampleNote.text: All titles, episode names, durations, counts, section names (محاور) and the sheikh's details are SAMPLE PLACEHOLDERS. Taqbaylit interface strings are a first draft for review by a native Kabyle speaker.

noteFont.text: Font decided: IBM Plex Sans Arabic for all Arabic text (bold titles, regular text), Inter for Taqbaylit and digits. Open licence, free to self-host.

noteHome.text: Home v4: a bento grid instead of one hero — the newest episode (big emerald tile), 'continue ep. 05' (ink), search, Taqbaylit (terracotta) and a quote. Then latest videos as branded covers, the series as an album-style track list, a Taqbaylit band, shorts, colour playlist tiles and a saffron mini-player pill.

noteWatch.text: Series & video pages: the series header is a big emerald block with its episode count; episodes read like an album track list with watched / continue / new states saved on the device. Video page: player, saffron 'Next' tile with autoplay off by default, chapters as time pills.

noteSearch.text: Search: press / (or tap search) anywhere for instant grouped results — episodes, videos, sections — that jump to the matching chapter. 'All results' opens the full page with filter chips, 'why it matched' and spelling help.

noteMobile.text: Phone: continue card first, newest episode, compact lists; mini-player above a 4-tab bar (Home · Series · Search · Playlists). The video page shows the current chapter and what's next; search shows instant results while typing.

noteKab.text: Taqbaylit: same layout mirrored left-to-right; Taqbaylit videos first, then the Arabic series and Arabic videos clearly labelled 's taɛrabt' with CC where captions exist.

noteColor.text: v4 colours (round 5): paper + ink base with flat colour blocks that each mean a kind of content — emerald = دلائل النبوّة series, terracotta = Taqbaylit, cobalt = short clips, saffron = play / continue / progress. Giant outlined numbers are the signature (covers, hero tiles, track lists). No gradients, no soft beige cards.
